messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Pager: kv-prefetch-contbatch spike detected in region-us-east-1 affecting Mistral-variant and Llama-quant shards. error_rate++ and latency p95 climbed above SLOs. auto-escalation to oncall. thread_ts=3332100000
Maya: oncall here, looking. initial graphs?
Sam: throwing up quick dashboard — looks like continuous-batching queue depth exploded for a subset of prefixes (high cardinality). CPU on host-gpu-32 at 92%. KV cache hitrate dropped ~30% in the window.
Luca: logs show repeated PrefetchKeyEvict events + large prefix fanout from a single customer pattern: many short prompts with unique prefixes. suspect prefix-cardinality leak interacting with MQA batching.
Maya: can we stop prefetch for the affected model group? prefer targeted rather than global.
Kai: I can patch routing to force Mistral-variant -> no-prefetch pool. rolling now to a small ring. command: `curl -XPOST \"https://ops-api/route/patch\" -d '{"model":"mistral-x","prefetch":false,"scope":"region-us-east-1","staging":true}'`
Sam: confirming the throttle. metrics dropping back a bit. contbatch queue depth -40% in 30s.
IncidentBot: Deploybot: route patch applied to 6 hosts (deploy id dpl-7781).
Emily: customer-facing triage: which customers hit? quick check shows two mid-market tenants saw increased 5xx for chat endpoints ~08:12-08:17. no data exfil.
Alex: internal sim confirms pattern — high-entropy conversational agents generating unique prompts per request leading to zero reuse in KV. Might be a bot.
Maya: plan: 1) keep prefetch disabled for mistral-x in us-east 2) reduce contbatch window from 50ms -> 20ms for all MQA models 3) apply temp patch to limit continuous batch size to 8 for affected pools.
Kai: rolling the contbatch window change now. config snippet: ```json
{"contbatch": {"window_ms": 20, "max_batch_size": 8}}
```
Sam: after window change, p95 latency dropped but token throughput dipped ~10%. acceptable trade for stability.
Luca: we also pushed a hotfix to the KV eviction heuristic to favor small-prefix culling earlier. hotfix id kv-ht-332. logs show eviction rate up x2 immediately, reclaiming memory.
Maya: good. customer impact assessment: two tenants impacted, estimated failed requests ~420 combined, degraded p95 for 6 minutes. recommend customer-notify minimal incident row. Emily can you draft?
Emily: will send a short note: apology + timeline + mitigation + ask for follow-up if they saw any data issues.
IncidentBot: Note: next-oncall is Sam in 2 hours. Handing off with the following checklist: keep mistral-x prefetch disabled until further notice, monitor eviction rate, watch contbatch queue depth and GPU CPU on host group.
Sam: taking next-oncall. quick mitigation follow-ups: 1) consider rate-limiting that prefix candidate if it's a single tenant creating high cardinality 2) enable alert for sustained prefetch fanout > 1000 keys/min 3) schedule root-cause follow-up with infra and runtime teams.
Maya: agreed. RCA meeting scheduled T+1h to decide long-term: probabilistic prefetch, per-tenant prefix quotas, or smarter prefetch TTLs.
Luca: saving logs & a sample of offending prefixes to s3://redwood-ops/incidents/3332100000/prefix-sample.txt
Kai: re-enabled prefetch for non-mistral pools at 08:35 after verifying stability. left mistral-x disabled.
Alex: adding note — models impacted: mistral-x (MQA path), llama-2.1-q (quant path) showed some tail latency but much less than mistral. Qwen unaffected.
Maya: final handoff message: monitoring stable for 25m, eviction heuristic hotfix deployed, contbatch window reduced, targeted prefetch disable in place. If anything spikes, page Sam. Closing thread for primary mitigation; will reopen if regressions recur. :white_check_mark:
